label: AI-OPERATED FIXED-MAP A* TIE COMPARISON; SYNTHETIC GRID

scenario.contributor: Junmo — guided wall-A removal choice and pre-run rationale
scenario.assistance: Student chose wall A from AI-proposed edits, supplied the recorded route-based rationale and predicted 6 minimum moves. AI supplied the base layout/options, clarification and transcription and will operate the already-tested paired evaluator. No independent full-map design or student code authorship is inferred.
scenario.studentChoiceAndReasonVerbatim: A를 없애는게 더 좋네. 왜냐하면 최단이동루트에는 A가 있고 B는 없어.
scenario.assistantClarification: A blocks the straight endpoint row; opening it makes that potential route available. The original valid shortest path cannot pass through blocked A. This is an assistant clarification, not a rewrite of the student quote or a student prediction of search work.
scenario.prediction: Student predicts a minimum route length of 6 moves after opening A. The raw response includes a trailing backslash, interpreted as an extra character after the numeric answer. No prediction of examined nodes or relative tie-rule performance was supplied.
scenario.controls: Only (5,0) changes from wall to open; dimensions, endpoints, all other cells, unit costs, heuristic, neighbor order, budget and planner source remain fixed. Compare each A* tie rule before/after and preserve full paths.
scenario.predictionScope: Minimum number of moves on the revised map only. No examined-node forecast is supplied.
scenario.executionNote: The 6-move forecast is recorded before the ready input is committed and executed. Preserve the original parent and compare unchanged planner sources and fixed budget.

conventions.primaryScore: Both A* variants use g+h; only equal-f ordering differs.
conventions.examinedNodes: Distinct examined nodes, including start and goal; not runtime or energy.
conventions.pathLength: Number of moves, excluding the start cell.
conventions.reference: Dijkstra shares the planner; independent BFS audit is in test/audit.test.mjs.
conventions.attribution: Input retains guided student choices and forecast; evaluator and execution are AI support.

execution.provenance: Student supplied guided choices and forecast; this command is assistant-operated. No student execution or independent map sample is inferred.
